hero.title: Shuofeng Grinding
hero.subtitle: Altruistic Thinking · Keep Promises · Pursuing Excellence
hero.desc: Dongguan Shuofeng Grinding Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2016, is a national high-tech enterprise integrating R&D, manufacturing, and service of polishing products. Headquartered in Dongguan, it has branches in Chengdu, Zhengzhou, Wuxi and Changsha, four production bases in Foshan and Dongguan, and two R&D laboratories.
about.title: Company Profile
about.desc1: Since its establishment, the Company has always focused on surface treatment of 3C industry, having mature grinding and polishing products and advanced ultra precision grinding technology. In view of CMP manufacturing procedure, the Company is able to develop a wide range of high value-added grinding wheels, sandpaper, polishing fluid, cleaning agents, etc.
about.desc2: The Company can provide complete polishing and grinding solutions and technical services. The average compound growth rate has been up to 40% in recent years.
